name: Conjure Animals
desc: You summon bestial spirits: an aura that deals damage and creates Difficult Terrain around you. Concentration.

token.name: Spirit Pack
token.note: A Large pack of spirit animals: move it up to 30 feet on your turn; creatures within 10 feet make a Dexterity save or take the Slashing damage. The area is Difficult Terrain for your enemies.
